description: Get US Treasury securities auction results (bid-to-cover ratio, high yield or discount rate, and the primary-dealer/direct/indirect bidder split), newest first. Set upcoming=true for the announced schedule of auctions not yet held. No API key required.

count.description: Total auctions fetched from Treasury, newest first (default: 100); `limit`/`cursor` page through them

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = all fields

from.description: Earliest auction date to include, `YYYY-MM-DD`; ignored when `upcoming` is true

limit.description: Maximum rows per page; omitted = curated default (25)

security_term.description: Security term filter as Treasury spells it (e.g. "13-Week"); ignored when `upcoming` is true

security_type.description: Security class filter ("Bill", "Note", "Bond"); ignored when `upcoming` is true

to.description: Latest auction date to include, `YYYY-MM-DD`; ignored when `upcoming` is true

upcoming.description: Return the not-yet-held auction schedule instead of auction records

name: get_treasury_auctions
title: Treasury Auction Results
